'''Jex''' was a citizen of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] who lived in [[Hedrett]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], his brother disappeared and Jex reported this disappearance to the [[Thaereian military|Navy of Thaere]]. He then waited outside their [[Hedrett]] warehouse and monitored their transmissions for the next day. His data showed no special transmissions made that would indicate a search underway. Consequently, when the Navy of Thaere reported back to Jex 24 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later that his brother was not on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], he suspected they had not actually searched at all. One of Jex's friends took this as evidence that the Thaereians were actually behind the disappearances.
